transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you into the clinic today?

Um... I guess I'm just having a hard time keeping things straight. Like, my schoolwork and... I run this little accessories shop. I just can't seem to get them organized at the same time. Everything kind of just ends up in piles—my supplies, receipts, assignment notes... due dates. I just... I don't really know what to do first.
Has keeping things organized been a challenge for you since childhood, or is this something that started more recently?

Um... I guess it's not really a new thing. My mom actually still has these old notes from my elementary school teachers. They... they usually said I was always getting out of my seat, or talking before they called on me. And that I'd just rush through group activities... even if I understood the work fine. So... yeah. It's been a while.
Do you often find yourself struggling with persistent or uncontrollable worry about everyday things?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I get stressed out when things pile up, but... I don't think I just sit around worrying about everything. It's just... normal stuff, I guess.
